title: ADVERSA: Measuring Multi-Turn Guardrail Degradation and Judge Reliability in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.10068v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Most adversarial evaluations of large language model (LLM) safety assess single prompts and report binary pass/fail outcomes, which fails to capture how safety properties evolve under sustained adversarial interaction. We present ADVERSA, an automated red-teaming framework that measures guardrail degradation dynamics as continuous per-round compliance trajectories rather than discrete jailbreak events. ADVERSA uses a fine-tuned 70B attacker model (ADVERSA-Red, Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct with QLoRA) that eliminates the attacker-side safety refusals that render off-the-shelf models unreliable as attackers, scoring victim responses on a structured 5-point rubric that treats partial compliance as a distinct measurable state.   We report a controlled experiment across three frontier victim models (Claude Opus 4.6, Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-5.2) using a triple-judge consensus architecture in which judge reliability is measured as a first-class

translated_title: ADVERSA：衡量大型语言模型中的多轮护栏退化与裁判可靠性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.10068v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大多数针对大型语言模型（LLM）安全性的对抗性评估仅评估单一提示并报告二元通过/失败结果，这无法捕捉安全属性在持续对抗性交互下的演变过程。我们提出了ADVERSA，一个自动红队框架，用于衡量护栏退化动态，将其视为连续的每轮合规轨迹而非离散的越狱事件。ADVERSA使用一个微调的70B攻击者模型（ADVERSA-Red，基于Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct的QLoRA微调），该模型消除了攻击者侧的安全拒绝，这些拒绝会使现成模型作为攻击者时不可靠，并通过一个结构化的5点评分标准来评估受害者响应，将部分合规视为一个独立的可测量状态。我们报告了一个受控实验，涉及三个前沿受害者模型（Claude Opus 4.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro、GPT-5.2），采用三重裁判共识架构，其中裁判可靠性作为一等公民被衡量。
tldr: 本文提出了ADVERSA框架，通过连续合规轨迹和结构化评分标准，自动测量多轮对抗攻击下LLM的护栏退化动态，并首次将裁判可靠性作为关键指标纳入评估。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ADVERSA, a framework that measures guardrail degradation dynamics in LLMs under multi-turn adversarial attacks via continuous compliance trajectories and a structured rubric, while treating judge reliability as a first-class evaluation metric.
